title: Owner-Approved Email Live Send Readiness
owner_mission: Tạo mọi thứ cần thiết để AI Company OS đánh giá điều kiện sẵn sàng trước khi cho phép gửi email thật trong tương lai, nhưng milestone này tuyệt đối chưa được gửi email thật.

department_questions.q1: Which sandbox email actions are candidates for future live sending?
department_questions.q2: What readiness requirements must be met before live send is authorized?
department_questions.q3: What is the required future live token policy?
department_questions.q4: Is sender identity verified for each action?
department_questions.q5: Is unsubscribe footer and physical address footer present?
department_questions.q6: Is rate limit policy defined and enforced?
department_questions.q7: Is bounce handling and reply routing defined?
department_questions.q9: What is the readiness score and missing requirements for each candidate action?
department_questions.q10: What must Boss fix before OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN unlocks live send?

department_answers.q1: All 3 sandbox actions from Milestone 1.0S (act_email_001, act_email_002, act_email_003) are candidates but blocked by multiple missing compliance requirements.
department_answers.q2: 19 readiness requirements as defined in compliance_checklist, including: consent, sender identity, unsubscribe footer, rate limit, daily cap, bounce handling, reply routing, suppression list, duplicate protection, and audit log.
department_answers.q3: Future live token is OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN, scoped per ACTION_ID, one-use, expires after use. Merge token and sandbox token must not enable live send.
department_answers.q4: Sender identity (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) is not yet verified in this milestone — remains as a required condition before live send.
department_answers.q5: Unsubscribe footer and physical address footer are defined in template rules but not yet enforced by verified provider. Marked as pending in readiness.
department_answers.q6: Rate limit policy: maximum 50 emails/day, 1 per recipient per 48 hours, defined locally only.
department_answers.q7: Bounce handling model: hard bounce = auto-suppress, soft bounce = retry max 2 times. Reply routing: all replies to sandbox-reply inbox, no real CRM routing.
department_answers.q8: Suppression list model: manual add only, local JSON file, no real sync to provider.
department_answers.q9: Readiness score 40-55 / 100 for all actions. Main missing requirements: sender_identity_verified, consent_confirmed, provider_not_fake, unsubscribe_tested.
department_answers.q10: Before OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN can unlock live send: (1) DNS records verified (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), (2) email provider configured and tested, (3) explicit consent model active, (4) suppression list seeded, (5) unsubscribe mechanism tested end-to-end, (6) rate limits configured in real provider, (7) owner provides OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN=<action_id>.
